import {getServerUserSession} from "./getServerUserSession";
export async function requireCmsAdmin(request:Request){let session;try{session=await getServerUserSession(request);}catch{throw new Response("Entre com sua conta.",{status:401});}if(session.user.role!=="admin")throw new Response("Acesso negado.",{status:403});if(request.method==="POST"){const origin=request.headers.get("origin");if(origin&&new URL(origin).host!==new URL(request.url).host)throw new Response("Origem inválida.",{status:403});}return session.user;}

import {archiveJson} from "./SourceArchive";import {db} from "./db";
export async function cmsNews(){const original=await archiveJson<any[]>("news.json");const entries=await db.selectFrom("cmsEntries").selectAll().where("kind","=","post").execute();const map=new Map(original.map(row=>[new URL(row.url,"https://archive.invalid").pathname,row]));for(const row of entries){if(row.status!=="published"||new Date(row.publishedAt)>new Date()){map.delete(row.path);continue;}let id=0;for(const c of row.path)id=(id*31+c.charCodeAt(0))|0;map.set(row.path,{id:-Math.abs(id),title:row.title,excerpt:row.excerpt,image:row.image,url:row.path,categories:row.categories,date:new Date(row.publishedAt).toISOString()});}return [...map.values()].sort((a,b)=>b.date.localeCompare(a.date));}
